name: Big Leaguer
description: (Tag:bound)(Tag:electric)(Tag:fire)(Tag:ice)(Tag:necro)(Tag:tool)(Tag:weapon)Dubbed "Chaos Throw", Big Leaguer is a Teigu of 6 throwable elemental orbs: Storm for whirlwinds, Explosion for blasts, Fire for searing flames, Ice for freezing, Lightning for electric bolts, and Rot for eroding mist. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.
